peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 8% below its local comparables; 14 of 44 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (33.3): 4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 17 of 51 similar developments. Context, not scored: resales in 70.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison; the size-matched price position applies.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: One-North MRT about 280 m, Buona Vista MRT about 520 m; closer than 25 of 51 similar developments (the same as 2). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 3 within 2 km; nearest Fairfield Methodist School (Primary) about 520 m; more than 9 of 51 similar developments (the same as 14). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 8 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 390 m), more than 39 of 51 similar developments (the same as 1); nearest hawker centre Holland Drive Market And Food Centre about 770 m; nearest park One-North Park about 50 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Holland Drive Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 7 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Hill @One-North, 14 new sales, about 140 m; Blossoms by the Park, 11 new sales, about 310 m; Bloomsbury Residences, 123 new sales, about 990 m; Hudson Place Residences, 226 new sales, about 1,090 m; Lyndenwoods, 7 new sales, about 1,180 m; Skye at Holland, 666 new sales, about 1,200 m; The Hillshore, 6 new sales, about 1,960 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 57 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,053 new sales and 297 resales (1,350 purchases); new sales were 78% of these purchases. Subsales (74) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Dover Drive GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 690 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 297 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 7 of 51 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 297 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 238 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (+24.8%). Planning-area private resales −1.4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
